verdict.rationale: The axis applies: an IP office sets renewal deadlines and late-renewal fees. The gov.uk guidance publishes an exact registration fee (at least £205), a 10-year trade mark term, and a stated renewal cadence, which partly covers the deadline element. Nothing in the pack shows a published penalty, late-fee or interest schedule for missing a deadline, so only a thin slice of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: published late-renewal or late-filing penalty figures, any interest schedule, exact deadline and grace-period dates for patent and trade mark filings, and independent corroboration.
